name: issue-triage
description: Issue triage tasks targeting the-debugger and the-librarian members

tasks.input: Triage this bug report: 'The app crashes on startup when the config file is missing. Log shows ENOENT at config/loader.ts:42'.
tasks.expectedOutput: A triage that identifies the missing-config crash as a high-severity startup failure, points at config/loader.ts:42, and proposes a clear error message or default config.

tasks.input: Triage this report: 'Users report the dashboard is slow only on Mondays. No errors in logs, CPU normal.'
tasks.expectedOutput: A triage that treats Monday-only slowness as a data-volume pattern (weekly batch jobs, report generation), lists hypotheses to verify, and proposes tracing the slow endpoint with timing instrumentation.

tasks.input: Triage this documentation request: 'How do I configure the rate limiter? The README mentions it but there is no example.'
tasks.expectedOutput: A triage that classifies this as a docs gap, locates the rate limiter configuration section, and proposes an example config with the valid options.
